title: customers.consent.withdraw payload
description: Saying NO, as a fact of its own. It never erases the grant it revokes: the period during which writing to that person was lawful is exactly the period an inspection asks about. `reason` is optional and stays optional — a form that demands an explanation to unsubscribe is the dark pattern GDPR art. 7.3 exists against.

channel.description: `any` IS accepted here and not on the grant, for ONE case: closing the unattributable legacy row the backfill left. It is a channel like the others — it does not retroactively withdraw `email` or `sms`, which are withdrawn one by one, exactly as easy as they were granted one by one (art. 7.3).
